cpu-conversion.description: shipped defaults: GpuColorConversion=0 and GpuSourceConversion=0, so ffmpeg converts NV12->BGRA on the CPU inside the decoder child (4 B/px over the pipe and through the upload heap) and the capture readback is BGRA (4 B/px)

gpu-conversion.description: both GPU conversion paths on: the decoder delivers NV12 (1.5 B/px over the pipe and the upload heap, converted by PSSourceNv12 on the GPU) and the capture plane is read back as NV12 (1.5 B/px). This is the audit's largest proportional item and it is a policy default, not a code change

gpu-color-only.description: capture readback only: the rendered frame is converted to NV12 on the GPU instead of by ffmpeg on the CPU. docs/USAGE.md records this one as off because the GPU is the scarce resource under the neural pass (8.35 vs 8.66 ms on an RTX 5070 Ti)

gpu-source-only.description: decoder side only: the source is decoded to NV12 and converted on the GPU, saving 2.6x pipe traffic. docs/USAGE.md records this one as off for correctness, not cost: the conversion assumes BT.709 limited range and nothing reads the source tags, so an SD or full-range clip renders with shifted colour
